nodes.label: CoGR: Co-Evolving Generative Retriever
nodes.author: Runpeng Dai, Kaili Huang, Changsung Kang, Ciya Liao
nodes.rationale: Retrieval framework that trains separate LLMs to generate keywords for queries and items, with co-evolving RL alternating between query-side and item-side optimization against frozen opposite-side index.

nodes.label: SFT Initialization Phase
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 of CoGR that establishes aligned keyword space by constructing query-side targets from relevant items' keywords, providing meaningful initialization for RL.

nodes.label: Co-Evolving Reinforcement Learning
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 of CoGR that alternately optimizes query and item generators with GRPO, with query-side receiving direct F1 reward and item-side receiving counterfactual marginal reward.

nodes.label: Counterfactual Marginal Reward
nodes.rationale: Item-side reward that measures change in query-side F1 caused by replacing item's keyword set, isolating item's contribution to overall retrieval quality.

nodes.label: Keyword Space Evolution
nodes.rationale: Analysis showing that co-evolving RL increases keyword specificity (reducing unigrams from 37% to 13%, increasing 3+ word phrases from 12% to 31%) and aligns query-item vocabularies.

nodes.label: WANDS Product Search Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Public product-search dataset from Wayfair with 42,994 items and ~200 relevant items per query, used to evaluate retrieval methods.

nodes.label: Internal APP Marketplace Dataset
nodes.rationale: Internal dataset with 13,500 training and 1,500 evaluation queries over 39,600 applications, ~1,000 relevant items per query.

nodes.label: Dense Retrieval Methods
nodes.rationale: Baseline retrieval methods including DPR, ANCE, and Qwen3-Embedding that map queries and items to shared embedding space for similarity-based matching.

nodes.label: Generative Retrieval Methods
nodes.rationale: Baseline methods including DSI, DSI-QG, RIPOR, and DeepRetrieval that generate item identifiers or keywords for retrieval.

nodes.label: Sparse Lexical Retrieval Methods
nodes.rationale: Baseline methods including BM25 and SPLADE-v2 that match queries and items through explicit terms and inverted indexes.
